description: Maersk helps users track ocean containers and bookings, air cargo, ground shipments, LCL cargo, and parcels, and browse Maersk schedules for ocean shipment planning. The app returns current shipment milestones, locations, estimated timing when available, tracking widgets for supported transport types, and an interactive schedules widget whose interface loads from the app's own origin.
